verdict.rationale: Gusto Business Compliance documents Proactive Compliance Alerts. These notify customers of upcoming compliance deadlines and new obligations, such as annual reports and annual tax reminders, which covers the reminder half of the story. Nothing in the evidence shows a calendar or list view of upcoming filing deadlines, and the evidence never says how far ahead alerts arrive or how they are configured. Missing for 10: a documented compliance calendar or deadline-dashboard view, detail on reminder lead time and delivery channels, and independent hands-on corroboration of the alerts.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, I can see a compliance calendar of upcoming filing deadlines and get reminders before each one

citations.quote: Proactive Compliance Alerts — Notifies customers of upcoming compliance deadlines and new obligations, including annual reports, as well as annual tax reminders
annual and initial report filing, government mail monitoring, proactive deadline alerts, and a dedicated compliance concierge team
